summary: Sustained 5xx wave from API gateway during tenant warmup caused by prefetch cancellation + NVMe compaction I/O spikes
description: Issue summary: Starting ~2026-03-13 08:12 UTC we observed a sustained elevation in 5xx responses at the API gateway for a single dedicated-tenant (AcmeDocs) during their traffic warmup. Impact: customer observed 20-40% error rates on short chat requests and failed large embedding uploads. Root-cause chain is not confirmed but initial signals point to prefetch cancellation amplifying NVMe compaction I/O which caused upstream runtime watchdog resets and connection churn, producing apigw 502/503 waves.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate tenant warmup: steady mix of short streaming chat sessions (avg 300 tokens) plus concurrent large embedding uploads (batch size ~1000 vectors). 2) Force prefetch enabled on tenant and trigger autoscaler scale-up of ephemeral pool. 3) Observe prefetch eviction/cancellation events in kvcache and concurrent NVMe compaction tasks. 4) Watch for runtime watchdog resets and apigw 5xx amplification under hedged retries.
logs_and_metrics_snapshot:
- apigw 502/503 spike starting 2026-03-13 08:12 UTC, peaking 08:20-08:35 UTC.
- runtime restarts correlated with NVMe iowait spikes (iostat: avg await 120ms -> 450ms).
- kvcache eviction rate increased 8x; prefetch cancel events spiked.
- hedged retry traffic amplified connection counts at apigw by 3x.
- sample error trace: runtime watchdog SIGABRT after async nvme compaction task timeout (see runtime logs at /var/log/runtime/tenant-ACME/2026-03-13.log lines 1248-1264).
investigation_notes: 08:18 UTC: SRE observed iowait spike on nodes serving tenant shards; correlated with kvcache compact activity.
08:22 UTC: Runtime team reproduced async nvme compaction overlapping with prefetch invalidation causing excessive CPU blocking in the runtime main thread on test cluster.
08:30 UTC: Api-gateway hedged retry policy amplified backlog when upstream started failing - retries caused more concurrent connections and accept queue pressure.

Hypothesis: combination of aggressive prefetch + background NVMe compaction on hot shards caused runtime main thread stalls which tripped watchdogs; watchdog restarts caused partial connection tears and apigw to surface 5xxs. Hedged retries and autoscaler warmup contributed to amplification.
Customer correlation: AcmeDocs was initiating a large scheduled ingest at the same time as chat warmup which increased embedding IO and prefetch churn.
comments: 2026-03-13 08:25 - Support (Aisha): Notified customer that we are investigating and requested request IDs and sample timestamps.
2026-03-13 08:32 - SRE (Marco Ruiz): Observed NVMe compaction task overlap; isolating compaction window and throttling compaction now as temporary mitigation.
2026-03-13 08:40 - Runtime (Liam): Pushed hotfix to disable async compaction during heavy prefetch windows on a small canary pool.
2026-03-13 09:05 - Support (Aisha): Customer confirmed error rates dropped to ~5% after mitigation but asked for timeline for permanent fix.
2026-03-13 11:10 - Product (Evelyn): Requested follow-up to add a scheduler-level circuit-breaker to prevent compaction during tenant warmup.
resolution: Mitigated: applied immediate throttling of NVMe compaction on affected shard pool and temporarily relaxed hedged retry settings at apigw for AcmeDocs routes. Customer error rate reduced from ~35% to ~5% within 30 minutes. A runtime hotfix was deployed to canary nodes to avoid long blocking compaction during prefetch invalidation. Full rollout pending validation.
remediation_actions: 1) Temporary: Throttle background NVMe compaction on tenant shards during detected warmup windows (applied 2026-03-13 08:35 UTC).
2) Temporary: Lower hedged retry aggressiveness for affected routes to reduce amplification (applied 2026-03-13 08:50 UTC).
3) Hotfix: Runtime change to make async compaction cooperative and cancelable when prefetch invalidation is in flight (canary deployed 2026-03-13 08:40 UTC).
4) Monitoring: Add alert for joint signals: kvcache prefetch cancellation rate + nvme iowait > threshold + runtime watchdog restarts.
follow_up_tasks: - Postmortem write-up and RCA (owner: Liam) due by 2026-03-17.
- Product to evaluate scheduler circuit-breaker for compaction vs prefetch (owner: Evelyn).
- Modify autoscaler warmup policy to avoid simultaneous burst of embedding uploads and streaming route warmups for dedicated tenants (owner: Infra).
- Roll out runtime hotfix to all zones after canary validation (owner: Runtime).
- Update runbook and customer guidance for large ingest + warmup events.
